requirements.text: Establish that the requested result is a local approved decision record with an explicit success criterion.
Identify and accept the consequences of the local export; illustrative economics are not verified real-world payoffs.
Establish that the unchanged local JSON export can be removed using its receipt, while preserving the audit history and consumed credits.

rollback: Use /receipts to find the local export, then /undo RECEIPT to remove its unchanged JSON file; preserve audit history and consumed credits.
